query.statement: SELECT DEFECT_CLASS_ID AS VALUE, DEFECT_CLASS_NAME AS TEXT FROM QMS_DEFECT_CLASS WITH (NOLOCK) WHERE IS_DELETED = 0 AND IS_ACTIVE = 1 AND (@severity IS NULL OR SEVERITY = @severity) ORDER BY DEFECT_CLASS_NAME

SELECT DEFECT_CLASS_ID, DEFECT_CLASS_NAME, DESCRIPTION, SEVERITY, IS_ACTIVE FROM QMS_DEFECT_CLASS WITH (NOLOCK) WHERE IS_DELETED = 0 AND (@severity IS NULL OR SEVERITY = @severity) ORDER BY DEFECT_CLASS_NAME
SELECT SPEC_ID AS VALUE, SPEC_NAME AS TEXT FROM QMS_INSPECTION_SPEC WITH (NOLOCK) WHERE IS_ACTIVE = 1 AND (@processId IS NULL OR PROCESS_ID = @processId) ORDER BY SPEC_NAME

SELECT SPEC_ID, SPEC_NAME, PROCESS_ID, ITEM_NAME, MEASURE_TYPE, NOMINAL_VALUE, TOLERANCE_PLUS, TOLERANCE_MINUS, IS_ACTIVE FROM QMS_INSPECTION_SPEC WITH (NOLOCK) WHERE (@processId IS NULL OR PROCESS_ID = @processId) AND (@measureType IS NULL OR MEASURE_TYPE = @measureType) ORDER BY SPEC_NAME

SELECT PARAM_ID, PARAM_NAME, EQUIPMENT_ID, PROCESS_ID, MEAN, UCL, LCL, USL, LSL, SAMPLE_SIZE, IS_ACTIVE FROM QMS_SPC_PARAM WITH (NOLOCK) WHERE (@equipmentId IS NULL OR EQUIPMENT_ID = @equipmentId) AND (@processId IS NULL OR PROCESS_ID = @processId) ORDER BY PARAM_NAME

SELECT DEFECT_ID, LOT_ID, EQUIPMENT_ID, DEFECT_CLASS_ID, DEFECT_COUNT, DEFECT_RATE, INSPECTED_AT, INSPECTOR_ID, IS_CONFIRMED FROM QMS_DEFECT WITH (NOLOCK) WHERE (@lotId IS NULL OR LOT_ID = @lotId) AND (@equipmentId IS NULL OR EQUIPMENT_ID = @equipmentId) ORDER BY INSPECTED_AT DESC

SELECT ITEM_ID, ITEM_NAME, INSPECTION_TYPE, MEASURE_TYPE, UNIT, DESCRIPTION, IS_ACTIVE FROM QMS_INSPECTION_ITEM WITH (NOLOCK) WHERE (@inspectionType IS NULL OR INSPECTION_TYPE = @inspectionType) ORDER BY ITEM_NAME

SELECT INSP_DEF_ID, INSP_DEF_NAME, PROCESS_ID, PRODUCT_ID, INSPECTION_TYPE, DESCRIPTION, IS_ACTIVE FROM QMS_INSPECTION_DEF WITH (NOLOCK) WHERE (@processId IS NULL OR PROCESS_ID = @processId) AND (@productId IS NULL OR PRODUCT_ID = @productId) ORDER BY INSP_DEF_NAME

SELECT METHOD_ID, METHOD_NAME, PRODUCT_ID, SAMPLING_TYPE, AQL_LEVEL, DESCRIPTION, IS_ACTIVE FROM QMS_INCOMING_INSP_METHOD WITH (NOLOCK) WHERE (@productId IS NULL OR PRODUCT_ID = @productId) ORDER BY METHOD_NAME

SELECT GAUGE_ID, GAUGE_NAME, GAUGE_TYPE, MODEL, SERIAL_NO, LOCATION, EQUIPMENT_ID, CALIBRATION_CYCLE_DAYS, LAST_CALIBRATED_AT, NEXT_CALIBRATION_AT, IS_ACTIVE FROM QMS_GAUGE WITH (NOLOCK) WHERE (@gaugeType IS NULL OR GAUGE_TYPE = @gaugeType) ORDER BY GAUGE_NAME

SELECT PLAN_ID, GAUGE_ID, PLAN_NAME, SCHEDULED_DATE, CYCLE_TYPE, ASSIGNEE_ID, STATUS FROM QMS_GAUGE_CALIBRATION_PLAN WITH (NOLOCK) WHERE (@gaugeId IS NULL OR GAUGE_ID = @gaugeId) AND (@status IS NULL OR STATUS = @status) ORDER BY SCHEDULED_DATE

SELECT RESULT_ID, GAUGE_ID, PLAN_ID, CALIBRATED_AT, CALIBRATED_BY, RESULT, CERTIFICATE_NO, NEXT_DUE_AT, REMARK FROM QMS_GAUGE_CALIBRATION_RESULT WITH (NOLOCK) WHERE (@gaugeId IS NULL OR GAUGE_ID = @gaugeId) ORDER BY CALIBRATED_AT DESC

SELECT RNR_PLAN_ID, GAUGE_ID, PLAN_NAME, SCHEDULED_DATE, OPERATOR_COUNT, TRIAL_COUNT, PART_COUNT, STATUS FROM QMS_GAUGE_RNR_PLAN WITH (NOLOCK) WHERE (@gaugeId IS NULL OR GAUGE_ID = @gaugeId) AND (@status IS NULL OR STATUS = @status) ORDER BY SCHEDULED_DATE

SELECT RNR_RESULT_ID, RNR_PLAN_ID, GAUGE_ID, EVALUATED_AT, EVALUATED_BY, GAGE_RR_PERCENT, NDC, JUDGEMENT, REMARK FROM QMS_GAUGE_RNR_RESULT WITH (NOLOCK) WHERE (@gaugeId IS NULL OR GAUGE_ID = @gaugeId) ORDER BY EVALUATED_AT DESC

SELECT REPAIR_ID, GAUGE_ID, REPAIRED_AT, REPAIRED_BY, FAILURE_DESC, REPAIR_DESC, COST FROM QMS_GAUGE_REPAIR_RESULT WITH (NOLOCK) WHERE (@gaugeId IS NULL OR GAUGE_ID = @gaugeId) ORDER BY REPAIRED_AT DESC
SELECT ITEM_ID, ITEM_NAME, CATEGORY, MAX_SCORE, DESCRIPTION, IS_ACTIVE FROM QMS_SPM_EVAL_ITEM WITH (NOLOCK) WHERE (@category IS NULL OR CATEGORY = @category) ORDER BY ITEM_NAME
SELECT DEF_ID, DEF_NAME, EVAL_CYCLE, TARGET_TYPE, DESCRIPTION, IS_ACTIVE FROM QMS_SPM_EVAL_DEF WITH (NOLOCK) WHERE (@targetType IS NULL OR TARGET_TYPE = @targetType) ORDER BY DEF_NAME
SELECT PARAM_ID, DEF_ID, ITEM_ID, WEIGHT, SORT_ORDER FROM QMS_SPM_EVAL_PARAM WITH (NOLOCK) WHERE (@defId IS NULL OR DEF_ID = @defId) ORDER BY DEF_ID, SORT_ORDER

SELECT RESULT_ID, SUPPLIER_ID, SUPPLIER_NAME, DEF_ID, EVAL_PERIOD, TOTAL_SCORE, GRADE, EVALUATED_AT, EVALUATOR_ID FROM QMS_SPM_EVAL_RESULT WITH (NOLOCK) WHERE (@supplierId IS NULL OR SUPPLIER_ID = @supplierId) ORDER BY EVALUATED_AT DESC

SELECT ACTION_ID, RESULT_ID, SUPPLIER_ID, ACTION_DESC, ACTION_DATE, STATUS, COMPLETED_AT FROM QMS_SPM_ACTION_RESULT WITH (NOLOCK) WHERE (@supplierId IS NULL OR SUPPLIER_ID = @supplierId) ORDER BY ACTION_DATE DESC

INSERT INTO QMS_DEFECT_CLASS (DEFECT_CLASS_ID, DEFECT_CLASS_NAME, DESCRIPTION, SEVERITY, IS_ACTIVE, IS_DELETED, CREATED_BY, CREATED_AT, UPDATED_BY, UPDATED_AT) VALUES (@defectClassId, @defectClassName, @description, @severity, 1, 0, @currentUser, @utcNow, @currentUser, @utcNow)
